subject: Discount approval needed — Acme Health impact to Feb forecast
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Acme Health — discount request and Feb forecast impact

Team,

Quick reminder as we head into the last forecasting window for February: the Acme Health opportunity (RDW-2026-AH-349) is outstanding and the buyer has asked for a 30% one-time discount for the first year. That discount materially changes our recognized revenue for Feb vs. March — finance flagged it this morning.

Action items:
- Marissa: confirm whether the customer will commit to the signed SOW and start date if we accept the discount. We need a firm close date for the commit.
- Dev (Deal Desk): need a decision from Deal Desk on whether to approve 30% (or a counter) and any required compensating controls (SOW wording, PO, payment terms).
- Laura (Finance): can you confirm whether we should count this at full list in the forecast until signature or at net after discount? We want to be consistent with revenue recognition guidance for enterprise discounts.

Attachments: RDW-Proposal-AH-349.pdf (pdf) — current markup; AH-Discount-Request-Form.xlsx (xlsx) — customer form.

I appreciate quick replies — forecasting closes on Monday EOD and I need to lock the numbers for the exec report.

Thanks,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme Health — discount request and Feb forecast impact

Rishi — quick update from my side.

Customer context: Katie Barnes (Procurement) pushed the ask; they want the larger discount for budget reasons but will sign if we can meet the commercial terms below. They are ready to move this month if we can get approval and deliverables aligned.

Proposed commercial (current deal):
- List ARR (first 12 months): $420,000
- Requested one-time 30% discount on year 1 (net first year $294,000)
- Preferred start date: 03/01/2026
- Payment: Net 30, PO provided

If Deal Desk approves the 30% we will have a signed SOW and PO by next week. If not, customer likely pushes start to March/April. They are firm on wanting a signature before March billing cycle starts.

Dev — can you run against the discount policy and confirm if an exception is allowed (we have a >25% threshold). If you need me to provide sales justification I’ll send a short note.

Laura — for forecast I recommend we mark this as commit if Deal Desk approves in the next 48 hours; otherwise mark as best case for March. Thoughts?

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference

--Attachment referenced: AH-Discount-Request-Form.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 08:47:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Acme Health — discount request and Feb forecast impact

Thanks for the context. Finance view below.

Short answer: we do not automatically recognize deals at list if there's a signed agreement that includes a negotiated discount. However for forecasting (internal commit), we need alignment on two items before counting this as a February commit:
1) Deal Desk approval in writing (email or signed deck) approving the 30% exception; AND
2) Signed SOW received (scanned PO + SOW ok) with a stated start date in Feb.

If both conditions are met by COB Monday (2026-02-24), we will include the net ARR ($294,000) in Feb bookings and adjust the revenue phasing accordingly. If Deal Desk declines the exception and Marissa gets a different outcome, mark as best case for March and do not include in Feb.

Impact calculation (for exec forecast):
- Feb target: $1,200,000 list bookings.
- If Acme is booked at list ($420,000) instead of net ($294,000), variance = +$126,000 to the forecast.
- If we include the discounted net as committed, our Feb recognized bookings decrease by $126,000 relative to list.

Please move related HubSpot deal to "Commit — Signed SOW" only after both conditions above are satisfied. I’ve added a note on the HubSpot record (link below) and attached the standard discount exception template.

Related: https://hubspot.com/deal/RDW-2026-AH-349

I’ll provisionally approve up to 25% discount for deals without exec sponsorship; anything >25% needs CFR (Chief Finance Rep) sign-off. Since this is 30% we need a short written justification from Sales describing strategic rationale (expansion motion, reference account, or strategic market entry). Marissa, please send that justification by EOD Monday if you want this included in the Feb commit.

Laura Bennett
Head of Revenue Finance | Redwood Inference

From: Katie Barnes <katie.barnes@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, procurement <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme Health — discount request and Feb forecast impact

Hi Marissa & team,

Thanks for the quick follow-up. Confirming Acme Health will sign the SOW with the 30% one-time concession if Redwood can commit to the 03/01/2026 start date and Net 30 payment terms. We can provide a PO tonight once we have an approved SOW.

We appreciate the flexibility — from our side this is the only way to get budget approved for H1. Please let me know if you need any additional procurement paperwork.

Best,
Katie Barnes
